test_title: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 19 Sept, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 1.
solution:
The correct answer is '**several**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage discusses the experience of Ojeya Cruz Banks moving to Ohio from New Zealand.
 
• The correct option should indicate a time frame that is appropriate for describing the number of years since her move.
 
• "Several" is the most appropriate choice as it conveys a reasonable, but not specific, number of years since her move.
 
• Other options such as "particular", "enormous", or "immense" are not appropriate in this context, as they do not fit the meaning of time span effectively.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

 

Complete Passage: *When Ojeya Cruz Banks moved to Ohio from New Zealand several__ years ago, she was overwhelmed by the logistics of uprooting her life.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **"Particular" **refers to a specific instance, which does not match the need for a general time frame in this context.
 
• **"Enormous"** and** "immense" **refer to size or extent, which does not fit the context of describing the time since her move.
